title: Correct First Journey consultation to three mood directions and sequential candidates
prompt: P0 continuation. Inspect current Ready branch HEAD including the previous character visual-quality-gate work. Correct the actual First Journey CHARACTER implementation to the recovered product contract. PHOTO is the sole/top Character Identity authority. Mood choices are expression/generation DIRECTION, never identity/personality classification. Remove/supersede any fixed 3-step personality/style consultation such as MOOD/POSE/GEAR and any fixed LIVELY/WARM/CALM candidate model. Build an extensible mood-tile pool, initially including: 신나! (활발, 씩씩, 장난꾸러기), 두근두근 (호기심, 모험, 발견), 포근해 (따뜻, 친근, 다정), 멋져! (자신감, 당당, 용감), 집중! (차분, 똑똑, 꼼꼼), 상상중 (신비, 창의, 이야기). UX: show the reference photo and explain it remains identity; child chooses THREE mood tiles, encouraging deliberately large emotional distance; each selected tile may optionally accept/select 1-2 small refining keywords. Data contract must be extensible as MOOD_TILE -> KEYWORDS -> PROMPT_DIRECTION. Candidate generation contract is sequential and explicit: fixed PHOTO identity -> selected tile A direction -> candidate 1; same fixed PHOTO identity -> tile B -> candidate 2; same fixed PHOTO identity -> tile C -> candidate 3; then compare all three. Each generation request must carry one distinct direction and explicit same-child identity constraints. Candidates must be the SAME CHILD and same quality/age/identity, but visibly far apart at first glance in expression, pose, energy, props, staging and atmosphere. Reject near-duplicate candidate directions and reject different-child drift. After comparison: choose preferred direction -> prepare resemblance refinement against ORIGINAL PHOTO -> final Character Master -> CONFIRM/COMPLETE. Preserve paid generation lock and stop before any paid call; no credits. Integrate with existing Visual Fidelity Gate by adding/using MOOD_DIRECTION_DISTANCE evidence and ensure static tests cannot claim generated-output PASS. Preserve premium reference-level mobile UI: pale sky-blue Ready world, navy/blue hierarchy, rounded white cards, deliberate dense-but-readable layout, >=44px touch targets, no emoji as final art, responsive iPhone Safari. Also keep the PHOTO->CHARACTER transition fail-safe fixes intact. Run bounded syntax/static/regression tests. Report exact changed files, removed/superseded old consultation assumptions, tests, and runtime/generated-output blockers. Work only Ready isolated branch; no main/prod/deploy/release/location tracking; do not move Snap growth/badges/Wish Shop into Ready.
